description:
PR #277 added the `explorer-tokens` PR-time job in
`.github/workflows/pr.yml`. It is gated on
`needs.ci-paths.outputs.needs-code-ci == 'true'`, which is true for any
code-CI path (`benchbox/**`, `tests/**`, `scripts/**`, …), so the job
boots a runner on every Python-only PR before its inner
`Detect results-explorer/src changes` step short-circuits the scan.

Add an `explorer-paths-needed` boolean output to
`scripts/path_filter_decision.py` (mirror the existing
`content-guard-needed` pattern) and switch the job's `if:` to use it.
The inner detection step can then be removed.

The classifier already has the matching pattern infrastructure;
`results-explorer/**` is in `.github/path-filters.yml` `code-ci`. Add
a new top-level rule key `explorer-tokens` (sibling of `safe-content`,
`content-guard`, `code-ci`) matching exactly `results-explorer/src/**`.
The classifier emits `explorer-paths-needed` (boolean) when any
changed path matches that key; the PR-time job's `if:` switches from
`needs.ci-paths.outputs.needs-code-ci` to
`needs.ci-paths.outputs.explorer-paths-needed`. The inner
`Detect results-explorer/src changes` step is then redundant and is
removed in the same change.

anti_patterns.dont: introduce a github-actions-side path filter (e.g. dorny/paths-filter) to gate the job
anti_patterns.why: diverges from the existing path_filter_decision.py classifier idiom and creates two sources of truth for path classification.

anti_patterns.dont: keep the inner `Detect results-explorer/src changes` step alongside the new outer `if:`
anti_patterns.why: the whole point of moving the gate to the classifier is to remove the duplicate detection.

anti_patterns.dont: widen the explorer-tokens scan rule beyond results-explorer/src/**
anti_patterns.why: the gate's purpose is the retheme contract on the public surface, not the e2e/test fixtures.

preserves.behavior: Existing ci-paths outputs (safe-content-only, needs-code-ci, content-guard-needed) and their semantics.
ci-required-result aggregator behavior — explorer-tokens skipped path still counts as success.

verifications.description: Classifier returns explorer-paths-needed=true when results-explorer/src changes
Workflow gate references the new classifier output
Inner detection step has been removed

work_units.evidence: Added .github/path-filters.yml explorer-tokens rule matching exactly results-explorer/src/**.
work_units.summary: Add explorer-tokens rule key to .github/path-filters.yml matching results-explorer/src/**

work_units.evidence: Extended path_filter_decision.py with explorer_paths/explorer_paths_needed and explorer-paths-needed GitHub output; generic explorer-tokens group output remains intact.
work_units.summary: Extend path_filter_decision.py to compute explorer_paths and emit explorer-paths-needed

work_units.evidence: Added classifier tests covering source-only matching, non-source exclusions, semantic alias, and generic group output.
work_units.summary: Add unit tests under tests/unit/scripts/test_path_filter_decision.py for the new output

work_units.evidence: Changed pr.yml explorer-tokens job gate to explorer-paths-needed, removed duplicate source diff detection, and made the scan step unconditional within the filtered job.
work_units.summary: Switch pr.yml explorer-tokens job to gate on explorer-paths-needed and drop the inner git diff detection step
